verdict.rationale: Viam's docs describe browser-based live camera streaming, keyboard/arm control panels, and built-in NAT traversal so operators can reach machines behind firewalls without networking setup, which together support remote teleoperation with visual feedback. However, there is no explicit 'teleoperation' feature, no data on control latency/responsiveness under poor real-world network conditions, and no independent/hands-on validation of video/control performance. Missing for 10: benchmarked latency/responsiveness data, independent field reports of teleoperation over real-world (e.g., cellular/satellite) networks, explicit teleoperation-specific tooling beyond generic web test panels.
